_comment: Killeen-Temple TX — GENERATION B workbook, the 48-column Port St. Lucie/Scranton layout (no research_key column; keys synthesized from the slug). NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_metro_area_flag: OWNER DECISION TAKEN 2026-07-31: metro_area is 'Killeen-Temple' (was 'Killeen'), same resolution as the Scranton ruling. Only 2 of the 25 venues are in Killeen itself: Temple 9, Belton 6, Fort Cavazos 4, Harker Heights 3, Killeen 2, Salado 1, Gatesville 1. The hyphenated form matches the stored Reno-Sparks / Greensboro-High Point / Scranton-Wilkes-Barre convention and the workbook's own label ('Killeen-Temple, TX Metro Area'). This value mints the public /courts/in/<slug> URL — /courts/in/killeen-temple — so it was free to change while nothing is published and would have been a URL migration afterwards. No state suffix: metroLabel() appends the per-row state itself.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Killeen-Temple, TX MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 3 MSA counties (Bell, Coryell, Lampasas), Coryell (Texas), Lampasas (Texas)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 15 geocoded venue(s) of 25 in this batch (observed lat 30.9537..31.4328, lng -97.7486..-97.3190).
